notes.title: Minor Patch #1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added settings panel with audio sliders.
[*] Added confirmation panel to "Start New" button. 
[*] Added button to lockpicking minigame to see tutorial panel again.
[*] Fixed some typos.
[*] Road Merchant and Box-boy should now recognize your gender correctly.
[/list]

If you encounter any dead end or any other bug don't hesitate to report it.
It's extremely hard to test every corner of this game.

notes.title: Demo now available – Play now during Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
🎉 The demo is live! 🎉
We’re excited to announce that our game demo is now available to play as part of Steam Next Fest!

This is your chance to:

[list]
[*] 🔥 Experience a slice of the gameplay before release
[*] 💬 Share your thoughts and help shape the future of the game
[*] ⭐ Wishlist the game if you enjoy it!
[/list]

👉 Play the demo now – it’s available for a limited time during Steam Next Fest!
👀 Follow us on Steam to stay updated with future announcements and development news.
